# PR #96 review (T-057)

Fresh reviewer subagent, no context from the implementer. Condensed to its findings; what was done is under "Fixes".

**Blocker 1.** `vydaje.vyrovnani.tsx`: `isAdmin` used in `toDecide` before its `const` → ReferenceError on Settle debts as soon as a claim to someone else is open.

**Medium 2.** `decide_payment_claim` settled every unpaid share between the two, including shares added after the claim. **Medium 3.** `languageOf` threw before 0040 (no `preferred_lang`, no `email_lang`), so every e-mail would fail its retries in the window between publish and migration.

**Low.** 4 `openClaim(null)` treated a one-expense claim as the whole-debt one; 5 an admin could confirm their own claim; 6 "Remove" on a past request opened the "Decline" dialog wording; 7 invitation expiry compared as strings; 8 English leaving-checklist e-mail had a Czech "Vzkaz:"; 9 private mode saved "cs" while the screen was English; 10 a reminder about another cottage was checked against the open cottage's debts; 11 the details editor couldn't empty a field and sent decimals raw.

**Checked, no findings:** tenancy of the new functions and table, re-created functions keep 0032/0022 behaviour, kind constraint superset, dedupe, webhook types, single-language templates, brand rename, error handling, t(), 44px, no personal data, scope.

## Fixes (same PR)

1 moved; 2 claims now record the shares they cover (`split_ids`) and confirming marks exactly those; 3 missing column/function → language unknown (Czech); 4 whole-debt match only; 5 the payer can't decide their own claim; 6 "Remove past request" wording; 7 `Date.parse`; 8 "Note:"; 9 falls back to the on-screen language; 10 only the open cottage's reminders are filtered; 11 whole numbers only, "an empty field keeps what was there" note.
